headline: LAD @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 5.48 at OAK 4.32, with a projected total of 9.79. Batter research is strongest for Mookie Betts, Shohei Ohtani, Freddie Freeman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Joey Meneses, Chuckie Robinson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
